prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pre-made friend or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "Select Companion"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag your pet across the screen, right-click for quick actions, or press Ctrl+Pet to start a chat.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "Configuring desktop overlay and syncing companion assets..."]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Adventure", "Bring an interactive companion directly onto your desktop screen in just 2 minutes.", "Quick Setup (2 mins)"]
5: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Sign in with the same account every time so your pet's custom memory and data are preserved."]
6: ["For best pet generation, upload clear, well-lit photos with a visible subject.", "Tip: Bright lighting produces the best custom desktop pets!"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop! Your pet is now roaming around. Click on them anytime to feed, play, or chat.", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Select Your Journey & Unlock Starter Items", "Choose how you want to create your pet today and receive a free starter hat!", "Bonus: Free Starter Accessory Included"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet and claim your official certificate of adoption!", "Enter Pet Name", "Official Adoption"]
